svg.title: AXIOM V2 — isolated deployment and retained fallback
svg.desc: One exact reviewed source builds per-platform offline packages. Each fresh Mac or Linux prefix has sparse source, own Python and OPA, private node state and stopped test processes. V1 services remain separate.
svg.text: AXIOM V2 — isolated deployment and retained fallback
Platform-specific packages use the same reviewed implementation; each node owns its operation and credentials.
fresh admission
Reviewed source and governed contracts
Exact Git commit / tree; independent baseline pin
Both dependency locks and approved platform OPA
No implicit promotion from Git source to authority
Prepared package + offline admission
External archive SHA + all member hashes
Original Git identity reconstructed; sparse code closure
Per-target wheels / OPA; no public dependency fallback
Fresh Mac V2 prefix
package/source/ — clean sparse Git snapshot
venv/ — own Python dependencies and pinned OPA
instance/ — independent node, key and credentials
instance/state/ — queue, raw bytes and receipts
instance/projection/ — bounded private view
Source-local Workbench drafts scoped by node
Loopback Workbench; candidate tested on :18875
Test process stopped; collector paused
Fresh Ubuntu V2 prefix
Same executable source and baseline contracts
Linux-specific prepared wheels and approved OPA
Independent prefix, node, key and credentials
Private SQLite / evidence / projection / drafts
Separate SSH tunnel to the loopback Workbench
Candidate tested on :18876; test process stopped
No replacement of existing systemd service
Retained V1 operating installation
Existing Mac Workbench / Ubuntu systemd service
Observed VM: adc4643, loopback :8766, legacy engine
V1 Ansible update / backup / recovery keeps its scope
No automatic state, key or publisher-authority import
CI / development and public publication
Native CI wrappers call the shared runtime
Source-side tools build releases and projections
Public documentation / static Viewer remain read-only
No hosted V2 API or Kubernetes workload deployed
The nodes share source contracts, not writable state or sessions. This is not replication or an HA pair.
V2 update: another exact-source package and fresh prefix. Restore is an inactive candidate; no automatic service cutover.
Product decisions still open: long-lived service management, supported target versions, hosted identity, SLOs and capacity.
The documented host proof binds implementation commit 756a28e; later documentation does not claim a host redeployment.
